title: From Topsham Quay and back again, Steve James ran a marathon a day around Britain

posts.facebook:
200 marathons in 200 days, 5,240 miles of coast, seven pairs of trainers. Steve James ran all the way round Britain.

How a retired banker ran 5,240 miles around Britain's coast in 200 consecutive marathons while University of Exeter researchers tracked what it did to his body, and how to start running or build towards back-to-back long days yourself.

A huge challenge is mostly a small one done again tomorrow: one marathon, then the next.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/stories/steve-james-200-marathons-coastline/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
